name: Volumetric Cloud Raymarching
definition: A technique to render volumetric clouds by tracing a ray through a 3D density field, accumulating color based on density, light scattering, and transmittance.
summary: Volumetric Cloud Raymarching is a real-time technique that simulates cumulus clouds by tracing rays through a 3D density field to enable realistic self-shadowing and light attenuation, differing from related methods by focusing on the traversal and shading loop.
